column7: A panic in the password-expiry gate's SetAccountState (post-verdict) reached the Recovery 500 a wrong credential never gets, lockout uncounted, unaudited; it is now returned as the gate's error wrapping ErrLoginWritePanicked and denied like a wrong credential. A panic in ConsumeMFARecoveryCode on /auth/mfa/verify (also after the consume committed) is now answered like that write's error and audited mfa.error: TestVerifyMFA_RecoveryCodeConsumePanicIsAnsweredLikeItsError; the same on /auth/mfa/stepup: TestMFAStepUp_RecoveryCodeConsumePanicIsAnsweredLikeItsError.
